messages:
Aria: Quick follow-up from today\u2019s all-hands: leadership asked for a compact \"how to explain\" pack for AEs and ICs. Can we get a couple of one-liners + a short objection playbook?
Kate (CEO): Aim: explain why Redwood is about predictable, production-grade inference, not just \"faster models.\" Two one-liners: 1) \"Redwood gives teams inference primitives and cost visibility so they ship features, not infra.\" 2) \"Get predictable latency, transparent unit economics, and easy migration paths across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private.\"
Theo: Love it. Can we add 3 quick rebuttals for sales? e.g., \"we can just run endpoints in our cloud\" or \"we'll optimize ourselves\"
Sam: Rebuttal ideas: - \"You can build that, but you’ll absorb months of infra work and unpredictable unit cost.\" - \"Optimizations like KV caching and continuous batching are subtle and brittle; our Optimize tooling is operationally proven.\" - \"If you need predictability or compliance, Dedicated/Private migration paths are built-in; its not an afterthought.\"
Priya: Legal: can we say \"X% cost reduction\" in sales decks?
LegalBot: Dont use percentages without signed customer case studies or GTM ops approval. Stick to qualitative claims and vetted vignettes.
Aria: Practical ask: what's the one-paragraph explanation for internal docs?
Kate (CEO): \"Redwood focuses on production economics for inference. We combine a GPU-optimized runtime with orchestration primitives (autoscale, canaries, model variants, KV caching) and Optimize recommendations so engineering teams get predictable latency, lower unit cost, and flexible deployment choices (hosted for speed, dedicated for predictable throughput, private for compliance).\"
Theo: Timeline guidance for sales: Hosted = days, Dedicated = weeks, Private = months?
Sam: Yes. Also note: migration Hosted->Dedicated: minimal downtime with warm-start canaries if owners run the migration playbook.
Aria: Any internal checklist PMs/ICs should use when prioritizing features against the mission?
Priya: Quick triage checklist: 1) Does it reduce variance in latency/cost? 2) Does it lower customer ops burden? 3) Can it work across deployment modes or have a clear migration plan? Score >=2 = high priority.
Kate (CEO): Add one last note for AEs: when a prospect names a competitor, respond with capability differences and customer stories, not attack lines. If they ask for numbers, escalate to GTM ops + Legal.
ops-bot: All-hands recording and slides uploaded: https://redwood.internal/all-hands/1777777777 :memo:
Aria: Great, I'll draft a one-pager + 3-slide rebuttal pack and drop in #product-playbooks. Thanks all.
